categories.main_business_segments: Sansec Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on cryptographic technology innovation and the development, production, sales, and services of commercial cryptographic products. Its main product lines include cryptographic chips, cryptographic modules, cryptographic machines, and cryptographic systems. The company provides comprehensive cryptographic solutions for network information security, serving industries such as finance, government, cloud service providers, telecommunications, energy, transportation, and emerging fields like AI, IoT, blockchain, and digital currency.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary research and development with core technologies including high-performance cryptographic computation, low-power secure hardware design, cross-domain cryptographic service platforms, and post-quantum cryptography algorithms. It has developed self-designed cryptographic chips (e.g., XS100, XT100, XT200, XR100), cryptographic modules, and systems supporting national and international cryptographic standards. Production combines in-house manufacturing of core processes (programming, testing, assembly) with outsourced PCB soldering, operating under order-based and stock-based production modes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sansec serves primarily cryptographic product and solution providers who integrate its products into network security solutions, as well as end customers across diverse sectors including finance, government, cloud service providers, telecommunications, energy, transportation, healthcare, education, and emerging digital economy sectors. Key customers include major cloud vendors, telecom operators, financial institutions, and government agencies, with expanding presence in overseas markets such as Hong Kong and Singapore.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant market penetration in regions including East China, North China, South China, and Central China. It has established subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Singapore to expand its footprint in the Asia-Pacific region and global markets. Its products and services cover domestic and international customers, especially in the Asia-Pacific digital security market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sansec operates primarily in the upstream segment of the network information security supply chain as a provider of core cryptographic hardware and software infrastructure. It supplies cryptographic chips, modules, machines, and systems to downstream network security solution integrators and end users. The company also provides cryptographic technical services, positioning itself as a foundational technology supplier in the digital security ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in cryptographic technologies, focusing on post-quantum cryptography, cloud-native cryptographic services, IoT security chips, high-performance cryptographic algorithms, and integrated cryptographic platforms. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 27% of revenue allocated to research, and actively participates in national and industry cryptographic standards development. Strategic acquisitions and ecosystem building in cloud security and emerging digital fields are key growth drivers.
categories.revenue_model: Sansec generates revenue primarily through direct sales of cryptographic products including chips, modules, machines, and systems. It also earns income from providing cryptographic technical services such as consulting, maintenance, and support. The company employs a direct sales model targeting both solution providers and end customers, with revenue recognized upon product delivery and service completion.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sansec is a leading domestic commercial cryptographic infrastructure provider in China, recognized as a top-tier player with the most high-security level (level 3) certified cryptographic products. It has strengthened its market position through strategic acquisitions of Jiangnan Keyou and Jiangnan Tianan, enhancing its product portfolio and market coverage. The company holds a competitive edge in cloud cryptographic security and emerging technology applications, with strong brand recognition and extensive industry partnerships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sansec reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 473 million, representing a 31.96% year-over-year increase, driven by expanded sales to core strategic customers and growth in cloud, telecom, energy, and transportation sectors. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 42.1 million, down 37.4% due to increased R&D and sales expenses. The company maintains total assets of about RMB 2.18 billion and net assets of RMB 1.85 billion, with a stable financial scale and ongoing investment in innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sansec emphasizes its proprietary cryptographic technology and comprehensive product ecosystem, offering fully domestically developed cryptographic chips, modules, machines, and systems that support national and international cryptographic standards including post-quantum algorithms. Its products deliver high performance, security, and reliability tailored for critical infrastructure and emerging digital economy applications. The company’s integrated solutions and strong R&D capabilities provide customers with secure, scalable, and compliant cryptographic services, differentiating it as a trusted partner in digital security.
